executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost per resident day ($23.27) was 189% of the Connecticut median ($12.32). Ask what drove the higher housekeeping cost (contracts, supplies, staffing or a one-time expense).
Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $185.39 per resident day (42.9% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was -5.2% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $296,682, 1.6% of the $18,235,553 direct care cost.

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $3,193,165, $32.46 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $1,571,919 (49.2%), allocated fringe $556,611 (17.4%), non-wage costs $1,064,635 (33.3%). Raw food was $897,399 ($9.12 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.61) and purchased dietary services $45,702.
Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost $2,289,281, $23.27 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.32). Wages $1,614,010 (70.5%), allocated fringe $571,516 (25.0%), non-wage costs $103,755 (4.5%).
Missing data: cost years 2019, 2021 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data)

missing_data.reason: Cost year 2019 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (direct care per resident day outside the plausible range; core figures (days, revenue or expenses) could not be read; payer days do not add up to the printed total). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

Cost year 2021 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (direct care per resident day outside the plausible range; nursing hours per resident day outside the plausible range; revenue per resident day outside the plausible range; core figures (days, revenue or expenses) could not be read; payer days do not add up to the printed total; resident_days: resident days missing). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

recommended_follow_up: Ask the home or DSS how housekeeping costs are reported on the cost report (in-house staff, purchased services or another department).

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
